OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 certified products require every component of a textiles production including all thread, buttons, and trims to be tested against a list of more than 1,000 regulated and unregulated chemicals which may be harmful to human health. About this item

  • SOFT & DURABLE 100% COTTON: Made from high-quality cotton that feels gentle on skin while holding up to daily wear and frequent washing.
  • CLASSIC CREWNECK DESIGN: Perfect for layering under school uniforms, button-downs, or wearing solo as a casual everyday tee.
  • LONGER LENGTH STAYS TUCKED: Designed with an extended hem to stay neatly tucked in during active play or movement.
  • TAG-FREE COMFORT & LAYFLAT COLLAR: Features a layflat neckline that won’t stretch out and a tag-free interior for itch-free wear.

Fruit of the Loom Boys' Cotton Shirt Underwear, 5-Pack

The shirts feature longer hems and layflat collars that stay put, while ribbed tanks stretch with movement. Ideal for school, play, and everything in between.

Product Description

Add style and comfort to your little one's wardrobe with these Fruit of the Loom Tank Undershirts. Designed with a flexible fit, they are made of a soft, rib knit fabric that is wonderful for layering. Each cotton a-shirt is made tag free and offers a flexible fit. Our sleeveless tanks provide a cooler, more comfortable alternative for an undershirt in warmer weather.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

About this Item

  • SOFT & DURABLE 100% COTTON: Made from high-quality cotton that feels gentle on skin while holding up to daily wear and frequent washing.
  • CLASSIC CREWNECK DESIGN: Perfect for layering under school uniforms, button-downs, or wearing solo as a casual everyday tee.
  • LONGER LENGTH STAYS TUCKED: Designed with an extended hem to stay neatly tucked in during active play or movement.
  • TAG-FREE COMFORT & LAYFLAT COLLAR: Features a layflat neckline that won’t stretch out and a tag-free interior for itch-free wear.

Product Description

Keep your boy cool, comfortable, and confident all day with this versatile multipack of soft cotton undershirts—featuring both crewneck short sleeve tees and sleeveless tank tops designed to suit every season and activity. Whether layered under school uniforms, button-down shirts, or worn on their own, these cotton undershirts provide a breathable, tag-free fit that keeps up with his busy lifestyle. The crewneck T-shirts are made with soft, durable 100% cotton and crafted with longer hems that stay tucked in, even during active play. Improved sleeve shaping offers greater mobility, and a layflat collar keeps the neckline smooth under clothes. The sleeveless tank undershirts offer a cooler alternative for warm days, made from ribbed cotton fabric that stretches comfortably with movement. A contoured fit and moisture-wicking technology keep him dry and fresh whether he's at school, on the playground, or relaxing at home. This multi-style pack is ideal for everyday layering, offering a reliable, breathable base he can depend on year-round. Plus, the tag-free design ensures irritation-free wear from morning to bedtime.
